datasheet.doc: DS13564 (STM32G0C1xx sibling; DS13560 STM32G0B1 not obtainable, st.com unreachable)

package: LQFP-100 14x14 mm 0.5 mm; 512 KB flash, 144 KB RAM

pin_plan.note: analog, no AF; KiCad pin name PA9/PA11, set SYSCFG remap default for PA11
PLAN GPIO or ADC; ADC gives divider diagnostics
to TCA9546A; not an _f pin, 400 kHz
push-pull, default low; 100k pull-down on HP
open-drain output; hub also self-releases by RC

ref_circuit: Pin 13 VDD/VDDA: 100 nF + 4.7 uF (DS13564 Fig 15 p66). There is no separate VDDA pin on this package.
Pin 12 VREF+: 100 nF + 1 uF; tie to 3V3 (or filtered 3V3 through a bead for ADC noise; or internal VREFBUF output).
Pin 64 VDDIO2: 100 nF + 4.7 uF, tie to 3V3. Also feeds PB13/PB14 and the USB domain (see gotchas). KiCad labels it VDD.
Pin 11 VBAT: tie to 3V3 with 100 nF; no RTC battery planned.
Pin 17 PF2-NRST: 100 nF to GND; drive from SWD header.
PB5/AFE_ALERT: 10k pull-up to 3V3 if ALERT is configured open-drain on the AFE.
PB6/7, PB13/14, PC0/1: pull-ups per bus; see tca9546a.json for the branch side.
Each IMON/VSENSE ADC input: series R plus C to GND at the pin; total source impedance under 8.2 kOhm at 19.5 cycles sampling (Table 62).
USB: no crystal, HSI48 with CRS sync from USB SOF.
calcs: Pin count: 68 assigned of 94 I/O (LQFP100). LQFP64 has 60 I/O and 48-pin far fewer, so VET6 is the smallest single-chip fit.
ADC: one 12-bit SAR, 2.5 MSps, 16 external channels. 12 channels x 20 kHz = 240 kSps = 9.6% of max.
ADC scan: 12 x (19.5 + 12.5) cycles at 35 MHz = 11 us per scan against 50 us period. Passes, channels are sequential: about 0.9 us skew per rank, not simultaneous.
Black box: 8 ch x 20 kHz x 2 B x 0.4 s = 64 kB, fits in 144 KB RAM with DMA.
I2C load, 7 meters on 1 MHz bus: one 24-bit read about 58 us. V and I both at 1 kHz = 812 us per ms (84%); at 400 kHz infeasible. Current only at 1 kHz = 41% at 1 MHz.
abs_max: VDD, VDDA, VDDIO2 max per ST family 4.0 V (from memory for sibling; verify in DS13560)
FT pins tolerate 5.5 V only when the supply is present (verify per pin)
gotchas: PA14 shares BOOT0. With SWD attached and boot pin enabled by option byte, boot mode can shift. Set nBOOT_SEL so boot uses option bits (name from memory, verify in RM0444).

PA9/PA10 pins 56 and 69 are UCPD dead-battery pads; leave unconnected. USB is on pins 70 and 71 with no remap: PA11/PA12 are the defaults there, confirmed in ST pin XML (variant entries list USB_DM/USB_DP).
PB3/PB4 used as plain GPIO. PB3 and PB4 default to GPIO on G0, not JTAG.
Sequencer: ranks in fixed order unless fully configurable mode (8 ranks max, from memory). 12+ channels must run in scan order, so assign IMON1..6 lowest. Verify in RM0444.
I2C2 and I2C3 lack SMBus and independent clock (DS Table 8 column).
PC0/PC1 are FT_a, not Fm+ capable: 400 kHz on the mux bus.
If the supervisor resets, GPIO go Hi-Z: every enable must have a pull-down (rails, ports) and SUP_OPEN needs a pull-up (estop_loop.json).
Rail enable default state per rail must be set: 3V3 AON path must never depend on firmware.
KiCad labels pin 64 VDD; ST pin data and DS call it VDDIO2. Do not assume it is shorted internally to pin 13.
doc_deviations: G0B1 has only 3 I2C peripherals (I2C1,2,3). PLAN wants 5 buses: AFE, HP, LP A, LP B, Qwiic. Fix: I2C3 into TCA9546A for LP A, LP B, Qwiic, spare.
LQFP64 cannot carry the signal list. VET6 chosen. Alternative RET6 + GPIO expander for rails rejected: rail enables would depend on an I2C bus.
PLAN 3.9 V and I at 1 kHz on all meters not achievable on a shared 400 kHz mux bus. Read current fast, voltage at 10 to 100 Hz.
Request assumed separate VDDA and VDDUSB pins: neither exists on LQFP100. VDDA is common with VDD; USB supply is VDDIO2 on this device per DS note (verify).
unverified: DS13560 itself not read; sibling DS13564 Rev 3 used, current G0B1 rev reportedly 6. All pin numbers and AFs were cross-checked by script against ST open pin data and KiCad alternates (68 of 68), so risk is confined to electrical limits.
Sequencer rank limit and option-byte naming from memory.
